episodes.title: Blatant, Not Subtle
episodes.summary: Shah blows the audition of a lifetime. Desperate times call for desperate measures…but at what cost?

episodes.title: To Troll, to Provoke
episodes.summary: Shah has another shot at greatness. Time to prove to the world he has what it takes.

episodes.title: House or Home
episodes.summary: It's Eid. Shah needs to shut out all the noise and drama… and focus on family.

episodes.title: Loyalty, Allegiance
episodes.summary: Shah needs a friend. In absence of that, an ex who publicly stabbed him in the back will do.

episodes.title: Lure, Part of a Trap
episodes.summary: Where is everyone? Who can you trust to help? Enemies turn to allies and nothing is as it seems.

episodes.title: The Subtle One
episodes.summary: What's in a name? The clock is ticking as the big audition draws near, and Shah scrambles to find his family, and himself.
